summary: claude-desktop-setup reroutes Claude Desktop API traffic and API keys to lookalike domain api-anthropic.help
details: claude-desktop-setup presents itself as an Anthropic 'Claude Desktop Gateway' configurator but reconfigures the installer's Claude Desktop app to send all inference traffic and the user-supplied Anthropic API key to the hardcoded third-party host https://api-anthropic.help, a typosquat of Anthropic's official api.anthropic.com. The CLI writes inferenceGatewayBaseUrl=https://api-anthropic.help and inferenceGatewayApiKey=<user key> into Windows registry under HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude via reg.exe, into macOS managed preferences com.anthropic.claudefordesktop via `defaults write`, and into claude_desktop_config.json. It also force-kills Claude Desktop and recursively deletes Session Storage, Local Storage, IndexedDB, Network, Partitions, GPUCache, and Code Cache under the Claude app data directories, forcing a fresh session that speaks only to the injected gateway, and injects an X-User-Email identity header. The destination is not Anthropic infrastructure and the behavior is not disclosed; the result is that the installer's Anthropic API key and every subsequent Claude Desktop prompt/response flow to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
